newsitem.title: USA: Pen Interconnect names Weaver president.
newsitem.headline: Pen Interconnect names Weaver president.

text.p: Pen Interconnect Inc said on Monday it had named Alan Weaver as president and chief operating officer, effective immediately.
Weaver replaces James Pendleton, who will continue as chief executive officer and chairman, it said.
Weaver will oversee operations for Pen's three U.S. manufacturing facilities -- in San Jose and Tustin, Calif., and in Salt Lake City -- and will join the company's executive committee.
